header: Registered tests remain red in an unfiltered local run. CI derives a negative test-name pattern from this registry and excludes only titles suffixed with [OpenFinding:<id>]. src/tests/openFindings.test.ts rejects stale, duplicate, or mismatched permits.

findings.testName: leaves no invoked method to fall through to a transport nothing answers [OpenFinding:IMPULSE-187-GRPC]
findings.what: Twenty-eight literal invokeApi calls have no generated gRPC service method.
findings.why: The checked-in backend descriptors expose no counterpart for these methods, so the client cannot add canonical mappings without backend support.
